/**
 * @name Potentially unsafe operations
 * @description Checking for eval, exec, subprocess, and pickle usage
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-operations
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 *       external/cwe/cwe-078
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::builtin(["eval", "exec"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "check_call", "check_output", "run", "Popen"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe operation: " + call.getFunction().toString()
findings.hypothesis: The package might use unsafe functions like eval, exec, subprocess, or pickle, leading to code injection, command injection, or unsafe deserialization.

/**
 * @name Eval Injection in v1 utils
 * @description Traces flow from function parameters to eval() in pydantic/v1/utils.py
 * @kind path-problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/eval-injection-utils
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-095
 *       external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

module EvalInjectionConfig implements DataFlow::ConfigSig {
  predicate isSource(DataFlow::Node source) {
    source instanceof DataFlow::ParameterNode
  }

  predicate isSink(DataFlow::Node sink) {
    exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode call |
      call = API::builtin("eval").getACall() and
      call.getLocation().getFile().getShortName() = "utils.py" and
      sink = call.getArg(0)
    )
  }
}

module EvalInjectionFlow = TaintTracking::Global<EvalInjectionConfig>;
import EvalInjectionFlow::PathGraph

from EvalInjectionFlow::PathNode source, EvalInjectionFlow::PathNode sink
where EvalInjectionFlow::flowPath(source, sink)
select sink.getNode(), source, sink, "Potential eval injection from parameter $@.", source.getNode(), "parameter"
findings.hypothesis: The eval() call in pydantic/v1/utils.py may be reachable from function parameters, leading to code injection.
Unsafe usage of subprocess in git utilities could allow command injection if arguments are user-controlled.

/**
 * @name Identify function calls at specific locations
 * @description Identify function calls at specific locations
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/identify-calls
 * @tags security
 */
import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
      call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "pydantic/_internal/_git.py" and call.getLocation().getStartLine() in [17, 27]
  ) or (
      call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "pydantic/v1/parse.py" and call.getLocation().getStartLine() = 42
  ) or (
      call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath() = "pydantic/deprecated/parse.py" and call.getLocation().getStartLine() = 54
  )
select call, "Call found here"
findings.hypothesis: Identify the specific function calls at potentially unsafe locations to assess risk.
